cases.title: Toggle Text Box Visibility
cases.description: Verify that clicking the toggle button (data-testid="toggle-button") changes the visibility of the text box (data-testid="text-box") by adding or removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Rapid Repeated Clicks on Toggle Button
cases.description: Verify that rapid repeated clicks on the toggle button correctly toggle the state and the final visibility state reflects the last user action.

cases.title: Close Text Box Using Close Button
cases.description: Verify that opening the text box and clicking the 'Close' button (data-testid="close-button") hides the text box by removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Multiple Open and Close Cycles
cases.description: Verify that performing multiple sequential open and close cycles using the toggle and close buttons functions reliably without state desynchronization.

cases.title: Populate Voice Dropdown on Text Box Open
cases.description: Verify that opening the text box invokes getVoices and populates the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid="voice-select") with available voices.

cases.title: Dynamic Voice Updates via voiceschanged Event
cases.description: Verify that the system listens for the 'voiceschanged' event and updates the voice dropdown options accordingly when available voices change.

cases.title: Select Voice with Specific Language Code
cases.description: Verify that selecting a voice with specific language codes like 'CN' or 'US' from data-testid="voice-select" sets it as the active voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Multiple Sequential Voice Selections
cases.description: Verify that making multiple sequential voice selections in the dropdown correctly updates and ensures the last selected voice is active.

cases.title: Read Entered Text Aloud
cases.description: Verify that after toggling the text box, entering text in data-testid="text-area", and clicking the 'Read Text' button (data-testid="read-button"), the system reads the text aloud using the selected voice.

cases.title: Read Text with Empty or Long Input
cases.description: Verify system behavior when the 'Read Text' button is clicked with empty text or very long text input inside the text area.

cases.title: Click Phrase Box for Speech and Highlight
cases.description: Verify that clicking a predefined phrase box reads the associated text aloud and visually highlights the box by adding the active class for 800 milliseconds.

cases.title: Sequential and Rapid Clicks on Phrase Boxes
cases.description: Verify that sequential clicks across different phrase boxes and rapid repeated clicks on the same box correctly trigger speech playback and visual feedback without conflict.

analysis.analysis: For requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-1: Normal scenario: Click 'Toggle Text Box' (data-testid="toggle-button") when text box (data-testid="text-box") is hidden, adding the 'show' class. Edge scenario: Click the toggle button rapidly multiple times to ensure the final state matches the last action. Boundary scenario: Toggling repeatedly without delay. Abnormal scenario: Interrupted click events or missing class toggle handling. For requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-2: Normal scenario: Click 'Toggle Text Box' to show the box, then click 'Close' button (data-testid="close-button") inside the box to hide it by removing the 'show' class. Edge scenario: Clicking close immediately after opening. Boundary scenario: Multiple open and close cycles. Abnormal scenario: Close button clicked when text box is already hidden. For requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-3: Normal scenario: Open the text box, trigger speech synthesis getVoices(), and populate data-testid='voice-select'. Edge scenario: Handle 'voiceschanged' event dynamically updating options. Boundary scenario: Empty voice list returned initially. Abnormal scenario: Web Speech API unavailable or failing to load voices. For requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-4: Normal scenario: Select a voice with specific language codes like 'CN' or 'US' from data-testid='voice-select' to assign it to message.voice. Edge scenario: Multiple sequential voice selections ensuring the last one is active. Boundary scenario: Selecting the default or first option. Abnormal scenario: Selecting a non-existent or invalid voice option. For requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-5: Normal scenario: Toggle text box, enter text in data-testid='text-area', select a voice, and click 'Read Text' (data-testid='read-button') to read aloud. Edge scenario: Reading empty text or very long text. Boundary scenario: Clicking read button immediately after typing. Abnormal scenario: Speech synthesis fails or is unsupported. For requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-6: Normal scenario: Click a predefined phrase box in the main section to read text and add active class for 800ms. Edge scenario: Rapid repeated clicks on the same phrase box. Boundary scenario: Sequential clicks across different phrase boxes. Abnormal scenario: Missing image or paragraph data in the phrase box array.
